name: Runemaster Runes of Quickness hastes the party's spells by 3% and extends Glyphic range by 6 yd (#564)
contract: Runes of Quickness 560527 (Arcane talent, passive): 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by
$s1%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, the range of your Glyphic spells is increased by $s2
yds.' Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (radius index 287, 100 yd) with aura 216
SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3%, so every party member's cast speed multiplier becomes
1/1.03 = 0.9709 of its baseline. Effect 1 is a caster-only aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 5
(SPELLMOD_RANGE) and 6 yd over family 38 class mask (0x7001, 0x8300000, 0xA0011), which includes Glyphic Ruin
520067 (mask0 0x1000, 35 yd). An ungrouped player receives nothing. Non-stacking is the existing spell_group
2000182 (EXCLUSIVE_SAME_EFFECT) and is not exercised here. Unlearning removes the party aura.

steps.label: The Runemaster carries Runes of Quickness
The party member receives the Runemaster's aura
The party member's spells are 3% hasted
The range bonus is the Runemaster's own
An ungrouped player is not affected
An ungrouped player's spells are not hasted
The party aura ends with the talent
The party member's haste returns to baseline
